scope: Corrected, separately gated SIMLOX 2017 CLI JSON probes: named Station instances with native empty-default canonicalization, and one-based inactive-row index 2, each derived from accepted K01.var04.
behavior_specific_dependency: K01.var04 established the accepted CLI-visible A01-derived model source and native mission behavior. K02 tests JSON structural fidelity on that same model. K01 GUI view and template scope is not a prerequisite for these CLI assertions and remains unverified.

excluded_v100_diagnostics.observed: Index 1 blanked BASE-01 and caused converter errors; named Station export added an empty default instance while preserving both named business rows and unchanged parent behavior.

manual.observed_rule: JSON has model/tables/columns/instances; datatype string/integer/double; null blank cells; inactive_rows lists row positions; -jimport/-jexport perform native CLI exchange.
manual.uncertainty: The manual does not specify zero-based versus one-based inactive_rows positions.

inactive2: Diagnostic test of whether Station.inactive_rows=[2] targets the second row while BASE-01 stays active. The v1.0.0 index-1 export omitted inactive_rows and blanked the targeted row, so a similarly lossy export is anticipated and would remain NO-GO for lossless JSON fidelity.
Check converter errors and warnings, accepted K01 h7 order/h8 launch/h11 completion, 72-bin report and terminal state; these may pass even if the inactive row and metadata are lost in export.
named: Native -jimport/-jexport preserves both explicitly named Station instances K02-BASE and K02-AUX, their keys/rows/nulls/types and all other authored rows and columns. One native-added blank default Station instance with one all-null row is allowed and must be recorded; no other authored row or metadata may change.
Unused K02-NAMED causes no change to the accepted K01 mission log, 72-bin numeric report or terminal state, with zero conversion errors and no new warnings.

gate: Each arm is accepted or rejected separately against its frozen source and native closure. For named, exactly the observed native-added all-null default Station instance is allowed; both authored named instances must remain exact. For inactive2, any loss of inactive metadata or authored row is NO-GO. Converter error, extra warning, changed mission or invalid output is NO-GO for either. No general multi-instance or inactive-index law is inferred from one row/table.
limitations: A01/K01 GUI views and SXT templates, general K02 JSON forms, inactive rows of other tables, larger precision values, other instance layouts and cross-engine behavior remain unverified.
A successful arm is a bounded K02 CLI slice, not full K02 or automatic prerequisite clearance for K04-K07.
